name: Bread Stuffing
description: Classic bread stuffing with sweated vegetables and poultry herbs, baked in a dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut rustic sandwich bread into 1-inch cubes, about 16 cups. Spread on sheet pans and dry at 250°F until dry but not browned, 1 hour, or leave out overnight.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-low. Add yellow onions, carrots, and celery. Cook, stirring often, until soft and golden without browning, 10 minutes.
Scrape the vegetables and butter into a large bowl. Add the bread and fresh parsley.
Stir in chicken stock, a little at a time, until the stuffing is moist.
Season with dried rosemary, dried sage, dried thyme, dried marjoram, celery salt, and black pepper. Taste and add salt as needed.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Spread in a buttered 9x13 baking dish and drizzle with chicken stock. Bake covered 30 minutes, then uncovered until the top is crisp, 15-20 minutes.
Bake it in the dish rather than in the bird: the turkey cooks more evenly and the brined drippings won't oversalt it. The bread can be cubed and dried a day or two ahead.
